components.name: Connection Recovery
components.description: Recovery surface with explicit status and retry; the application supplies the focus trap, global block and account recovery actions.
components.html:
Reconectando ao seu espaço

Suas conversas continuam aqui. Vamos liberar o aplicativo assim que a conexão voltar.

Reconexão automática em andamento
components.css: .ds-recovery {display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;width:min(540px,calc(100vw - 48px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 92px);overflow-y:auto;padding:36px 30px 28px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--bg-main,#171621);color:var(--text,#f2f0f8);box-shadow:var(--shadow-overlay,0 20px 64px #0006);text-align:center;font-family:"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;}.ds-recovery h2 {font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0;}.ds-recovery p {font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text-muted,#938ca8);max-width:380px;margin:0;}.ds-recovery-symbol {position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:110px;height:110px;color:var(--accent,#ffb020);}.ds-recovery-symbol>span {position:absolute;inset:0;border:1px solid var(--accent-line,rgba(255, 176, 32, 0.45));border-radius:50%;animation:ds-reconnect 2.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite;}.ds-recovery-symbol>span:nth-child(2) {animation-delay:1.2s;}.ds-retry {min-height:36px;padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-elev,#201e2c);color:var(--text-soft,#d1cde0);font:600 13px "Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms;}.ds-retry:hover {background:var(--bg-active,#322e42);}.ds-retry:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--accent,#ffb020);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-recovery-status {font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted,#938ca8);}@keyframes ds-reconnect {0% {transform:scale(.65);opacity:0;}20% {opacity:.8;}100% {transform:scale(1.05);opacity:0;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-recovery-symbol>span {animation:none;}.ds-retry {transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
Annoy places community navigation and conversation in a compact desktop workspace. Familiar server, channel, message and member positions keep the product easy to read; deep indigo surfaces, amber controls and the supplied Annoy logo give it its own identity. Light mode uses warm ivory surfaces and a darker amber accent.

The interface uses calm tonal layers, disciplined spacing and brief state changes. Product workflows and server content stay real; all interface copy is Brazilian Portuguese. The official Discord view retains its own interface and theme.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar desktop navigation with the supplied Annoy logo.
Deep indigo dark mode and warm ivory light mode.
Compact controls with generous message line height.
Flat workspace planes; lifted dialogs and feedback.
Shared, keyboard-accessible primitives and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Semantic Palette Rule
rules.body: Use the semantic CSS variables or their Tailwind aliases in new UI; preserve dark, light and system theme behavior. Status colors communicate status, while amber marks selection and primary actions.

rules.name: The Conversation First Rule
rules.body: Keep body copy readable and message history stable. Do not animate the arrival of the entire message history.

rules.name: The Workspace Plane Rule
rules.body: Separate persistent workspace columns with tonal surfaces and subtle borders. Reserve strong shadows for floating layers.

dos: Do use shared UI primitives for text fields, choices, menus, permissions, dialogs and loading states.
Do preserve visible focus, descriptive Portuguese action labels and keyboard dismissal with focus restoration.
Do test both themes at the default desktop size and the minimum width of 940px, including settings, permission targets, both calendars, media fullscreen and anchored profiles.
Do use the single SVG brand source and regenerate packaged icons with npm run brand:icons.
Do keep motion brief, honor reduced motion and load optional interfaces on demand.
Do preserve explicit settings saves, guarded exits and visible request failures.
Do keep activity opt-in, ephemeral and limited to self and mutual friends.
donts: Don't borrow the Discord mark or blurple palette for Annoy chrome.
Don't substitute synthetic conversations or members for real first-run empty states.
Don't hardcode new presentation colors outside the semantic palette.
Don't replace workspace columns with a collection of floating cards.
Don't expose Electron or styling implementation details in user-facing flows.
Don't reintroduce channel collapse, duplicate member toggles or autosaving settings forms.
Don't add native selects, browser confirm/prompt dialogs or separate unshared form controls.
Don't infer activity access from a shared server/DM or populate activity when detection is unavailable.
